generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential integers starting at 1, unique per table; never NULL; never overwritten by any planter (ties, nulls, group_sizes, different_values) — planters must exclude PK columns.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_fk: Sample from parent PK pool (existing parent rows only); allow NULL with probability 0.15 when nullable; NEVER emit orphan values (no parent PK + 1000); unmatched_join_rows is satisfied only by NULL child FKs and by parent rows with no children.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_numeric: Uniform integer in [min-1, max+1] of observed range; include boundary values at each listed literal and one step on each side.
generic_sampling_rules.real_numeric: Uniform real rounded to 1 decimal in [min-1, max+1]; include boundary values at each listed literal and one step on each side.
generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Sample from observed value pool; enforce 20-50% duplicate share on non-PK, non-FK text columns by capping fresh distinct values; add near-variants (case changes, trailing space, empty string) with probability 0.10.
generic_sampling_rules.text_date: Sample from observed date-string pool; preserve format; add one-day-shifted variants for boundary testing.
generic_sampling_rules.text_enum: Sample from observed distinct values; ensure each value appears at least once; boundary values listed in per_column_exceptions are injected into the enum pool (not ignored); add near-variants (case changes, empty string) with probability 0.10.
generic_sampling_rules.null_rule: For every nullable column, each instance contains at least one NULL row; NULL share follows compact database share (5-30% for columns with null_rows pattern, 0% otherwise); planted NULLs are never replaced to satisfy a rule; planters run in order nulls -> group_sizes -> ties -> different_values, and each planter excludes PK columns and re-verifies prior structures.
generic_sampling_rules.planter_order: nulls, then group_sizes, then ties, then different_values; each planter excludes PK columns; after all planters, re-verify group-size and tie structures and re-plant if overwritten.

targets.rule: Parent rows without children: at least one artist with no volume, one volume with no music_festival. Child rows with NULL FK: volume.Artist_ID and music_festival.Volume get NULL in 5-30% of rows. No orphan (non-NULL, non-existent) FK values are permitted; foreign_keys pragma must be ON during insert.

Duplicate share 20-50% on these non-PK, non-FK DISTINCT columns; ensure COUNT(DISTINCT col) < COUNT(col). PK columns (artist.Artist_ID, music_festival.ID) and FK column volume.Artist_ID are excluded (PKs cannot duplicate; FK duplicates arise naturally from FK sampling).

NULL share 5-30% of generated rows; at least one NULL row per column per instance; _plant_nulls must actually set NULLs in music_festival.Result (verify Result is in cols and not overwritten by later planters).

At least two rows tie at rank 1 for DESC order on artist.Age and artist.Artist; artist.Artist_ID is a PK and is excluded from tie planting (PKs must stay unique). For music_festival.Result ensure ties at rank 1 and rank 100 on COUNT(*) and COUNT(DISTINCT id) in both ASC and DESC.

artist.Age: include values 22,23,24,25,26,31,32,33. music_festival.Result: include 'Nominated','nominated','','x','NOMINATED' — these are injected into the EnumSampler pool; the enum formula for Result is relaxed to allow these boundary variants (see semantic_rules_and_formulas). volume.Weeks_on_Top: include 1,2,3.
Ensure at least 2 rows per group with different values for MAX/SUM/AVG and MIN aggregates.

Group sizes for music_festival.Result must include groups of size 1, 2, and >=3; when fewer than 3 distinct values exist, draw from the enum/observed pool or synthesize distinct values rather than collapsing to pool[0].
Ensure at least one Category group has COUNT(*) > 2 and at least one has COUNT(*) <= 1; requires a dedicated aggregate_boundary planter.

semantic_rules_and_formulas.formula: Result IN ('Nominated','Awarded','nominated','NOMINATED','','x') OR Result IS NULL
semantic_rules_and_formulas.evidence: Observed values Nominated, Awarded; boundary variants required by comparison_boundary

semantic_rules_and_formulas.formula: Category IN ('Best Song','Best Lyrics','Best Sound Song') OR Category IS NULL

supporting_evidence.music_festival.Result_enum: Rows: Nominated, Awarded; boundary variants nominated, NOMINATED, '', x added per comparison_boundary
supporting_evidence.music_festival.Category_enum: Rows: Best Song, Best Lyrics, Best Sound Song

uncertainty: Date_of_ceremony has only one distinct value; no order rule applicable. Famous_Release_date format varies; no formula. Volume_Issue and Issue_Date formats are free text; no formula. Artist name duplicates observed (5 distinct of 7 rows) but no formula. music_festival.Result enum formula relaxed to include boundary variants; if boundary variants are not intended, remove them from comparison_boundary and restore strict enum.
